Remark
[Globally essential sequences and limits] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0251 1. Remark 8.12\group dilations-of-singularities

In some arguments one uses the special case \[ \sup \Bigl\{ |\Rm (x,t)| : x\in \mathcal M^n,\ t\in [0,t_i]\Bigr\} \le C|\Rm (x_i,t_i)| \] of global curvature essentiality.
